items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Tony Watkins was a singer with the band

ctx.x: That was in '68 and we did -- no, I think that was '69 or '70. We did a concert in Barcelona and I rehearsed the choir for ten nights and the night of the concert the place was crowded, the cathedral was crowded, people were standing and sitting all over the floor, all over everywhere and I had -- I rehearsed the band but the director, he directed it, see, and he knew everything, he remembered everything that I did and we had a number there that Tony Watkins, he started, 'Don't Get Down on Your Knees Unless…
